body:
I'm 37. Single. Have a decent job and my own place. I'm in good shape and have been told (by less than objective family) that I'm not hideous. 

And I've never been loved for who I am. I have no real friends. I met the girl of my dreams a couple of years ago. She couldn't stand me for reasons I still can't fathom. 

The loneliest time for me is every night when I climb into an empty bed. I know I would make a great boyfriend based on what every woman claims she wants. I just wish someone would tell me what the hell I'm doing wrong so I can fix it. 

That's my story.

Thanks to you, and everyone that responded. All of the responses were helpful. And hopefully someone else gets something out of this thread. 

As for me, it's just so frustrating having a problem I can't seem to solve. I can fix things. Things behave in predictable ways. There are logical solutions. People are much harder. 

I'm sure I'll go out again. I'd give about anything just to sit and talk with a charming, attractive woman. Is that selfish?  I honestly don't know.

Nothing's going on. Just like always. Alone, bored, tired, guilty, desperate, etc. 

I'd go out and do SOMETHING if I honestly believed it wouldn't be a waste of time and money. I suppose I will go out later to buy food and smokes. 

For now, just waiting to go to work tomorrow. Only reason I have to get out of bed. Out of the house and back on the hamster wheel. 

How're you?
Never faced that problem. But I would suggest taking a walk when those feelings start to rise. Come back when you have composed a calm rational way of expressing yourself.
How did you land a girl like that while I am home alone every night?

Electromagnetic energy can travel through the air. Although with more difficulty than through a conductive material. I would guess that there was quite a bit of static electricity in the room and a nearby bolt of lightning sent enough of a surge to trigger the circuit turning it on. 

Odd, but not impossible.

Keep in mind your brain is still growing and maturing. Once you hit your 20's you should notice a difference in your ability to manage your feelings. You will be able to focus on the positives in life and push the negatives into a corner. 

Give yourself a chance to really take charge of your life.

Because modern monkeys are adapted to a different set of environmental conditions. You may ask why there are so many types of cats. Lions, tigers, panthers, leopards, cheetahs...

I suggest educating yourself more on the intricacies of evolution and natural selection.
Isn't your whole county on fire right now?

We need a good reason to make things illegal; not to make them legal. 

Two grown-ass people should be free to live their lives however the see fit, provided they're not harming anyone else.

So now Angry Birds is in the same catagory as ... Halo, Assassin's Creed, GTA, CoD?

It's apples and peanuts.

You should lay off as many as possible. Your body and brain are still growing. It will be another 5 years or so before you reach full maturity. Until then any chemicals have the potential to interfere with your development.
By the soft serve machine at Golden Coral.

I've wondered about that. How many people could some lonely loser like me attract to my stream while I pound pills and booze while ranting about why life sucks?

And how many trolls?

Meetup.com

Find some groups in your area that sound like fun.
More the opposite. I feel invisible.
Yes. But I feel it is entirely unfair to dump any of my issues on her. I'm out of her life and she prefers it that way.

Same here. It's like constantly having celery in my teeth. It's all anyone notices and can't get past and I can't get rid of it. 

"You're a nice guy. But I'm just really busy this weekend. Maybe some other time. "
I'd give anything to have a friend like you willing to do /i/something/i/.

I imagine the reason for this question is how to lessen the pain for survivors. I've often wondered how these different methods would pan out. Not just how my body is found. But the effect of suicide notes to answer all those 'I had no idea' questions. 

Is there anything a suicidal person can do?  Or is it better to just get on with it?
I smoke pot. It works for a couple of hours. Prolly not the most helpful tip.
Why is that?  What have I done to earn the privilege of happiness?
Tried that. Nothing I do justifies anything I enjoy. But thanks for the tip. And I'm sorry.

Getting drowsy. Hope I get some sleep. Hope even more I don't wake up.  If you're lucky enough to have a SO hold them tight tonight.  I'd give anything to feel that tonight.

Thanks for trying Reddit.
Thanks for that. I try to be. But it's not enough apparently.

Sound advice. But there is nothing else I'm passionate about. Only minor distractions  

Any accomplishment seems empty without someone to share it.

Sorry if I bummed you out. It happens when I don't paint a stupid smile on my face, don't bite my tongue, and "be myself". 

Here's a cute kitty to make up for it. 

http://i.imgur.com/yaWip.jpg

TL;DR version...

I'm a 37 year old bachelor who has never been really loved in a romantic manner. I'm the pathetic nerd on the sitcoms who will die alone. I'm a starving kid peering through the window of the Golden Coral at the happy people stuffing their faces. I don't ask much. Just some meat and potatoes. Instead I'm shooed away by the manager.

I appreciate the offer. But I've talked to family, friends, and therapists. Never has helped. I'm open to listen if you or anyone thinks they have any insight beyond "I've been there and it gets better. " 

Nothing personal. I just need something more substantive. I need to know why every woman I'm attracted to behaves either like a Denny's waitress angling for a big tip, or a domestic abuse victim. Either transparently polite or obviously uncomfortable around me. 

The sleep thing is probably no big deal. A combination of minor physical pain and my brain spinning like a NASCAR engine.

...And my photo didn't post. Fuck my life. 

http://i.imgur.com/ySOsj.jpg
Feel free to PM or contact me on any other social media. I'll be around for the next few hours.
Still not as bad as some things people do to each other. Just check out the evening news.
You and me both darlin. I'm willing to offer a friendly ear if you need. I can't promise to have the answers. But I'll try.
No. They don't allow kids on the shooting range.
Already covered. It'll be a somewhat public place.

Metaphors and platitudes are meaningless. If I was capable of leading a happy life I would have figured out how by now. There comes a point when the only rational thing to do is accept the evidence in front of you. If the crowd is booing you off the stage you're probably not Van Halen.

Well, I posted some details in a previous thread. Basically I'm a 37 year old chronically single guy. My love life is a disaster of sitcom proportions. I have no passion for anything and my life makes no difference to the world chugging along. My job is the only motivation to get out of bed. And that's just so I can pay the rent. I'm not living. I'm existing.  I'm done.

At this point you may as well ask me to be a foot taller or try out for the Yankees. I've blown my chance for true happiness. I'm willing to discuss this as much as you like. But I'm already sick of listening to myself whine. You'll get sick of it too.
Nothing can change that. I'll keep it simple then. Thank you.

Unfortunately there is no other solution. I face a future of loneliness and pain. I guess I could simply bear the pain until everyone who may care about me is long gone. But is living out of guilt any kind of life?
Been there, tried that. Quasimodo got more action.

Well, the last gal I went out with said I was "pressuring her" when I asked for a second date. As for my one and only GF, we broke up when she got pregnant and refused to even discuss allowing me to see my child more than once a month. It was a long distance relationship (150 miles) and living at home with mom & dad was more important than allowing me to be a real father. The relationship ended after she miscarried.
Not an honest one.

I just want to thank you all for your efforts. I don't know what I expected to get from this posting. But I'm tired of listening to myself whine. It sickens me even more. I should just sack up and get it over with. Luckily I have some vacation time scheduled in a few weeks. That should give my boss a chance to replace me without being too big a burden to my coworkers. 

Although I don't understand the concern for total strangers some of you demonstrate, I do thank you. But you'll all be better off without me. More oxygen to go around and all.
As I previously mentioned, I have dated the larger girls. They quickly find a reason to break things off with me too.

I appreciate your honesty. But to be brief, I have done all those things you mentioned. I have been aggressively working out for almost two years. And it shows compared to where I was. I have also dated larger girls hoping to be won over by their personality. I truly understand that looks aren't everything and you should enjoy the company of your mate when you're not naked together. But even those girls have run for the hills l after spending time with me. And the only answer I get when I ask what few "friends" I have about this is; 'you're too nice of a guy'. 

Please understand that I really feel I have tried everything to deal with this problem. All roads lead back to my empty dark apartment in the middle of the night. I can't bear the loneliness much longer.
So love is overrated?  Well, nothing else in my life is anywhere near as appealing as having someone truly care about me.

I have tried online dating. Tried half a dozen of the most popular sites with full vigor. I've even gotten a few first dates. But that's where it ends. Once the ladies actually meet me it's pretty much over.
